entities.name: A0A2P1BT06 FCS1
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot reference is an exact sequence match to the 707-residue query: 100% identity and full-length coverage.
Annotated as trans-feruloyl-CoA synthase, EC 6.2.1.34; homodimeric enzyme.
Annotated GO activities include ATP binding, metal-ion binding, and trans-feruloyl-CoA synthase activity.

entities.name: RHEA:19389 feruloyl-CoA synthesis
observations: Ferulate + CoA + ATP ⇌ feruloyl-CoA + ADP + phosphate.
The curated UniProt direction is formation of feruloyl-CoA, ADP, and phosphate from ferulate, CoA, and ATP.

entities.name: FCS1 sequence architecture
observations: The query is 707 amino acids, approximately 74.9 kDa, and contains CoA-binding, succinyl-CoA-ligase-related, and ATP-grasp Pfam domains.
The domain architecture supports an ATP-dependent CoA-ligase/synthetase function, but exact substrate specificity is established primarily by the exact curated sequence match.
